name: Once Upon an Electric Dream
source:
Princess Rosavel is on a deep space mission in search of...something...If only she could properly remember why she's brought herself to the Phantom Prism in the deepest part of space. With her loyal servant and friend Miel joining her in this voyage across the stars, can she come to understand these shades of memories and inexplicable heartache?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1264090/]Steam[/url]]
